# Team Tilt

> > Team Tilt provides organizational coaching, agile transformation, and facilitation training for charities and nonprofits seeking to drive impact through collaborative change.

Team Tilt specializes in helping the charity and nonprofit sector adopt agile methodologies, implement Scrum and Kanban frameworks, and develop leadership capabilities for organizational change. The organization offers training courses, coaching services, and community peer learning through the Charity Agile Leaders Club.

## Key Topics

- Agile methodology
- Organizational change
- Agile transformation
- Scrum
- Design Sprint
- Charity sector
- Agile coaching
- Team empowerment
- Leadership development
- Change management
- Agile adoption
- Nonprofit management
- Facilitation skills
- Team development
- Agile mindset

## Core Services

- [Agile in Action course](https://teamtilt.co.uk/agile-in-action): Agile in Action course covering Scrum, Kanban, Design Sprints for charities
- [Facilitation skills for change makers](https://teamtilt.co.uk/facilitation-for-impact): Online facilitation training course for charity change makers and innovators
- [Bespoke Agile Coaching](https://teamtilt.co.uk/bespoke-agile-coaching): Customized agile coaching for organizational change in charity sector
- [Intro to Agile Workshop](https://teamtilt.co.uk/intro-to-agile-workshop): Interactive introductory agile workshop for nonprofit organizations

## Community & Learning

- [Charity Agile Leaders Club](https://teamtilt.co.uk/charity-agile-leaders-club): Charity Agile Leaders Club community for peer learning and agile adoption
- [Get started](https://www.teamtilt.co.uk/get-started): Getting started guide for agile implementation in nonprofit organizations
